profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I have 20 years of hands-on experience as a software engineer in IoT and smart home systems, from design, development and on-time delivery to re-engineering of business processes and system support. With strong system design skills and understanding of all level protocols, I am honored to contribute to all the projects I have worked on. Studying database gave me insights of how to manage information efficiently. Designing proprietary systems and protocols is always an opportunity for me to improve my own design skills. I am also equipped with analytic problem solving skills by handling various time-critical issues of commercial products.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed back-end server to manage the lifecycle of modem for connected car service with mobile carrier using Java, Spring, Soap and RestAPI
- Developed back-end server for the lifecycle of modem for wifi-hotspot and music service with mobile carrier using Java, Spring and RestAPI
- Developed daily monitoring tool using Python

positions.title: Visiting Researcher
positions.description:
- Analyzed IoT services of Global and startup companies (i.e. Amazon, Apple, Google, Uber and startups)
- Analyzed system architecture, topology, protocol and setup process of IoT services

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
IoT Service Development      
- Designed and implemented android applications which can share images,  drawing memo, calendar data, to-do lists and shopping lists between home appliances (refrigerators) and mobile devices 
(https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.samsung.familyhub&hl=en_US)
- Designed and implemented server/client protocols using RESTful 
- Designed and implemented group management system for one family with samsung account and SMS authentication 
- Remotely managed and coordinated teams in India to develop iOS applications for Family Hub.
- Led technical support for Family Hub post global launch by resolving issues and addressing additional requirements and updates

Team Lead, Smart Home / Smart Grid   
- Managed team of five domestic and three offshore associates for Smart Home and Smart Grid service development on Android and iOS
- Developed Android applications for users to be able to monitor status of appliances and control remotely. Participated for global launch of the applications
(https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.samsung.smarthome)
- Designed and implemented SHP(Smart Home Profile with RESTful) from network connection to server registration for appliances using mobile devices, which became part of the company’s standard libraries 
- Developed local discovery and connection with SSDP on Android 
- Developed Android applications and smart TV applications to control appliances automatically in order to save electricity cost
- Designed and implemented company standard protocols between mobile devices, appliances and smart meters for users to get electricity cost, energy usage and DRLC.
- Led Smart Grid testbeds for three years with three major Korean telecommunication companies (SKT, KT, LGT) and Korea Electric Power Corporation(Kepco)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed Home Network systems including WallPad, GuardPad, PublicEntryPad and each counterpart server system for apartments and townhomes
- Designed and implemented video communication system such as visitor call, intercom, broadcast, security alarm, elevator call  (C#)
- Designed architecture and protocols between client pads, server and third-party devices such as elevators and vehicle control
- Designed and implemented applications on client pads using Layer architecture to communicate with server and firmware
- Deployed and managed Home Network for more than 10,000 homes in multiple sites. Addressed client issues and requests
- Designed and implemented Home Network 2.0 with RUP and use case modeling
- Applied Feature model and Software Factory to pack and release for each site’s different requirements

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Jan, 2003 ~ May, 2004	: Tiniatek, GangNam-gu, Seoul - Programmer
- Making Stress tool for RPC Server with JAVA
- Integrate RPC Server and Data Caching System

Dec, 2002 ~ Dec, 2003	: Tiniatek, GangNam-gu, Seoul – Assistant Manager
- Spec. Upgrade for Web Application Server(WAS) from J2EE 1.2 to J2EE 1.3
- Monitoring server development with SNMP and JNI

Aug, 2002 ~ Nov, 2002	: Etri, Daejeon – Programmer
- Caching System development for Mobile Application Server
- UseCase Modeling & Java
